content: The function FrIf_StartCommunication shall wrap the FlexRay Driver API function Fr_StartCommunication() by: 1. Translating (based on static FrIf module configuration) the FlexRay CC index Fr If_CtrlIdx into a tuple (FlexRay Driver | Driver-specific CC index Fr_CtrlIdx). 2. Calling Fr_StartCommunication() of the determined FlexRay Driver module with the parameters determined as described above.
